description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/google-trends-explorer" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Bulk Google Trends data for any keyword: interest over time, interest by region, top and rising related queries and topics, plus today's trending searches. Any country, time range, category, or YouTube/News/Shopping search. Pay only per successful keyword; blocked terms are free.

inputSchema.description: Fetches Google Trends data per search term: interest over time, interest by region, top and rising related queries and topics, optionally today's trending searches. Example: {"searchTerms":["ai agents"],"geo":"US","timeRange":"today 12-m"}. Pricing: $0.004 per search term with data.

category.description: Google Trends category number, 0 for all categories.
category.title: Category ID

geo.description: ISO code like US, GB, DE, or US-CA. Leave empty for worldwide.
geo.title: Country or region code

language.description: Interface language for names, e.g. en-US, de, es.
language.title: Language

property.description: Which Google search the trend data comes from.
property.title: Search type

searchTerms.description: Keywords or phrases. Each one is fetched separately and returns one result row.
searchTerms.title: Search terms

trendingNow.description: Adds one row per currently trending search in the chosen country, with traffic and news links.
trendingNow.title: Also get today's trending searches

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

inputSchema.title: Google Trends Scraper: Interest, Regions, Related Queries
